build_aria_conditional_generation: build an AriaForConditionalGeneration model for multimodal image-text generation with Mixture of Experts
create_aria_processor: create an AriaProcessor that tokenizes text and processes images for the Aria multimodal model
configure_aria_model: configure an AriaConfig with vision and text sub-configs including MoE parameters and projector settings
process_aria_images: process images with AriaImageProcessor including resizing, padding, and patch splitting for multimodal input
run_aria_generation: run inference on AriaForConditionalGeneration to generate text conditioned on image and text inputs
